'''Tierre Brown''' (born June 3, 1979) is an American [[basketball]] player.

==Career==
Brown graduated from [[McNeese State University]] and began his career with the [[NBA]]'s [[Houston Rockets]] in 2001. He played fifteen games for the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] in [[2002-03 NBA season|2002–03]], and three games for the [[New Orleans Hornets]] for the [[2003-04 NBA season|2003–04 season]]. Brown would spend the [[2004-05 NBA season]] with the [[Los Angeles Lakers]], and played in most of their contests that year. He was named the MVP of the NBA Development League in 2004.
His stint with the Raptors was short lived as he was cut on October 22, joining the [[NBA Development League]]'s [[Albuquerque Thunderbirds]] in January 2006. Led The Team To The NBDL Championship. He then switched to [[Europe]], playing with Italy's [[S.S. Basket Napoli|Basket Napoli]], agreeing to part ways in February 2007.

Brown played a total of 134 games in his NBA career and holds averages of 3.9 points, 1.2 rebounds, and 2 assists per game. His final NBA game was on April 11, 2005, in a 97 - 108 loss to the [[Phoenix Suns]]  where Brown recorded 8 points, 2 steals, 1 rebound and 1 assist.

On November 7, 2008, Brown was selected with the 9th pick in the first round of the [[2008 D-League Draft|2008 NBA Development League draft]] by the [[Anaheim Arsenal]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/draft_board_08.html 2008 NBA D-League Draft Results] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151105201943/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/draft_board_08.html |date=2015-11-05 }}</ref>

On February 27, 2015, Brown signed with [[Gaiteros del Zulia]] of Venezuela.<ref>[http://www.eurobasket.com/Belarus/news/396169/Gaiteros-land-Tierre-Brown,-ex-Tsmoki-Minsk  Gaiteros land Tierre Brown, ex Tsmoki-Minsk]</ref>
